run_interaction_job: run an InteractionJob to spin up ECS instances and collect commands from Turkers via Mephisto
run_interaction_log_listener: run an InteractionLogListener to poll S3 for new commands and create annotation jobs
process_s3_logs: process S3 logs from a batch to parse and collate commands into a single list
get_batch_id: get the batch ID from an InteractionJob instance for tracking dashboard sessions
run_interaction_pipeline: run a TaskRunner with an InteractionJob and InteractionLogListener to collect and annotate commands
